author: Facti0n
body:
Hello, I have just finished another update and added a ton of new things (This may be the final release). I will be putting the map available for download in case you want to see it. Also, I have decided to get rid of tnt on the map.

Updates:
-Instead of just having a normal void, I have added water right above it for the people who will be boating to middle.
-Added a Dock
-Got rid of tnt
-Added minor texture adjustments
